$comment: Pinned upstream sources for seed v2. commitSha values are upstream commits that were read and built locally; artifact sha256 values are of the exact .wasm files committed under tests/fixtures/seed-v2/wasms/ and deployed to testnet. Rebuild + verify with scripts/upstream/build-upstream.sh (pass --update-lock only in a PR that documents why hashes moved).

build.note: Built with rustc 1.81.0 (era-appropriate for the pinned 2024 commit): rustc 1.99 cannot compile ethnum 1.5.0 (E0512) as locked by upstream. The governor build embeds contracts/governor/src/dependencies/votes.rs contractimport! of soroban_votes.wasm, so the votes crate MUST build first and the artifact be present at contracts/governor/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/soroban_votes.wasm (mirrors upstream Makefile ordering: votes before governor).

sourceBounds.$comment: Read from contracts/governor/src/constants.rs and settings.rs require_valid_settings at the pinned SHA.

artifacts.name: Script3 votes (SEP-41 admin path)
artifacts.note: Default features (bonding) were disabled: the admin path mints real checkpointed voting power directly; see tests/fixtures/seed-v2/README.md.

build.note: Built with `stellar contract build` (28.0.0) inside each example crate; plain cargo build fails the repo's build-script check that requires stellar-cli >= 25.2.0.

sourceBounds.$comment: Read from packages/governance/src/governor/storage.rs (set_voting_period rejects only 0; set_voting_delay unbounded; propose uses snapshot = current-1 for threshold, vote_snapshot = current + voting_delay, vote_end = vote_snapshot + voting_period) and examples/fungible-governor/governor/src/governor.rs __constructor.
sourceBounds.proposalIdRule: keccak256(targets.xdr ++ functions.xdr ++ args.xdr ++ description_hash) where description_hash = keccak256(description bytes)

events.proposalCreated: topics ["proposal_created", proposal_id: BytesN<32>, proposer: Address]; data [targets, functions, args, vote_snapshot, vote_end, description]
events.voteCast: topics ["vote_cast", voter: Address, proposal_id: BytesN<32>]; data [vote_type: u32, weight: u128, reason: String]
